overall_notes: The paper focuses on constrained unsupervised text style transfer with explicit constraints preservation. The extraction quality is generally good with minor normalization needed. The paper uses LSTM-based encoder-decoders (not transformers) with GAN framework. Human evaluation was conducted with clear guidelines and inter-annotator agreement reported (Krippendorff's alpha).
